title: Respecting Hardcore
description: Tired of being dead in hardcore after first death? Not a problem anymore!
body:
# What is this mod doing?
So, basically this mod allows you to have few lives and when you lose all of them you can't play anymore. You can change amount of lifes with mod config using command 
```
/function fewlifes:config
```
## WARNING
**Do not create world as hardcore, create it just as survival.**
